g.title: sharpen_cas
g.text: contrast-adaptive sharpening after AMD FidelityFX CAS: more enhancement where there is headroom, less near clipping or on strong edges
same-size in / out - 3x3 neighbourhood - line-buffer architecture, about two lines of latency - 1 pixel per clock
pixel = CHANNELS x COMP_W bits (default 3 x 8), component 0 in the LSBs

g.title: inp
g.text: first beat must carry tuser: data before SOF
is dropped (SOF_ERR); tlast must mark the last
SIZE and SHARPNESS latched at start of frame
input stalls when all four line buffers are in use

g.title: dp
g.text: stages 0-2, X1-X4, R1, R2, Y1, Y2 + output register
RAM read: all four buffers, same column
(edges clamp); centre e goes on a delay line
v = e + kd (v = e when BYPASS)

g.title: lb
g.text: row r is stored in buffer (r mod 4)
each MAX_W pixels: one write, one read port
block RAM: about two lines of latency,

g.title: outeng
g.text: output row oy, read column oj = 0..W
waits until the rows needed for oy have arrived
W + 1 clocks per line: 1 pixel per clock
